headlines.name: Research.WeightedIncidence.product_weighted_incidence
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq J] {r : I → ℕ} {c : J → ℕ} (a : I) (s : J) (k : ℕ),
  ∑ X, ∑ p, ↑↑X a ↑p.2 * ↑↑X (↑p.1) s ≤ ∑ Y, ∑ p, (↑↑Y a ↑p.2 + 1) * (↑↑Y (↑p.1) s + 1)

headlines.name: Research.WeightedIncidence.weighted_level_recurrence
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (a : I) (s : J) (k : ℕ),
  Fintype.card (Research.WeightedIncidence.Level r c a s k) * ((r a - k) * (c s - k)) ≤
    Fintype.card (Research.WeightedIncidence.Level r c a s (k + 1)) *
      ((r a - (k + 1) + (Fintype.card J - 1)) * (c s - (k + 1) + (Fintype.card I - 1)))

headlines.name: Research.SurvivalConvolution.finite_nbu_convolution
headlines.statement:
∀ (F G : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ F k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ G k) →
      F 0 = 1 →
        (∀ (a b : ℕ), F (a + b) ≤ F a * F b) →
          (∀ (a b : ℕ), G (a + b) ≤ G a * G b) →
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              0 < n →
                (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j ≤
                  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, F k * G k) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j - 1)

headlines.name: Research.SurvivalConvolution.finite_nbu_reciprocal
headlines.statement:
∀ (F G : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ F k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), 0 ≤ G k) →
      F 0 = 1 →
        G 0 = 1 →
          (∀ (a b : ℕ), F (a + b) ≤ F a * F b) →
            (∀ (a b : ℕ), G (a + b) ≤ G a * G b) →
              ∀ (n : ℕ),
                0 < n →
                  1 / ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, F k * G k ≤
                    1 / ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i + 1 / ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j -
                      1 / ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, G j)

headlines.name: Research.CompositionSurvival.tail_nbu
headlines.statement:
∀ (a q i j : ℕ),
  Research.CompositionSurvival.tail a q (i + j) ≤
    Research.CompositionSurvival.tail a q i * Research.CompositionSurvival.tail a q j

headlines.name: Research.CompositionSurvival.tail_sum
headlines.statement: ∀ (a q : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (a + 1), Research.CompositionSurvival.tail a q k = (↑a + ↑q + 1) / (↑q + 1)

headlines.name: Research.CompositionSurvival.composition_reciprocal_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ (a b q p n : ℕ),
  a < n →
    b < n →
      1 / ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Research.CompositionSurvival.tail a q k * Research.CompositionSurvival.tail b p k ≤
        (↑q + 1) / (↑a + ↑q + 1) + (↑p + 1) / (↑b + ↑p + 1) - (↑q + 1) * (↑p + 1) / ((↑a + ↑q + 1) * (↑b + ↑p + 1))

headlines.name: Research.ReciprocalZero.zero_count_times_convolution
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (a : I) (s : J),
  2 ≤ Fintype.card I →
    2 ≤ Fintype.card J →
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ↑(Fintype.card (Research.WeightedIncidence.Level r c a s 0)) *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
              Research.CompositionSurvival.tail (r a) (Fintype.card J - 2) k *
                Research.CompositionSurvival.tail (c s) (Fintype.card I - 2) k ≤
          ↑(Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c))

headlines.name: Research.ReciprocalZero.zero_entry_probability_reciprocal
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (a : I) (s : J),
  2 ≤ Fintype.card I →
    2 ≤ Fintype.card J →
      ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
        ↑(Fintype.card (Research.WeightedIncidence.Level r c a s 0)) /
            ↑(Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c)) ≤
          ↑(Fintype.card J - 1) / (↑(r a) + ↑(Fintype.card J - 1)) +
              ↑(Fintype.card I - 1) / (↑(c s) + ↑(Fintype.card I - 1)) -
            ↑((Fintype.card J - 1) * (Fintype.card I - 1)) /
              ((↑(r a) + ↑(Fintype.card J - 1)) * (↑(c s) + ↑(Fintype.card I - 1)))

headlines.name: Research.ReciprocalZeroPhysical.accepted_half_seven
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (R : Option I → ℕ) (P : Option J → ℕ)
  (D : Option I → Option J → ℤ),
  Math115.CompletionAdjustment.Bounds D →
    ∀ (L : ℕ),
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤ Fintype.card (Option I) →
          2 ≤ Fintype.card (Option J) →
            ∑ i, R i = ∑ j, P j →
              (∀ p ∈ Math115.CompletionAdjustment.negative D, Fintype.card (Option J) * L ≤ R p.1) →
                (∀ p ∈ Math115.CompletionAdjustment.negative D, Fintype.card (Option I) * L ≤ P p.2) →
                  Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.Table R P) ≤
                    2 * Fintype.card (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.Accepted R P D)

headlines.name: Research.ConstantPaddingAcceptance.reference_edge_acceptance_seven
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ) (B : I → J → ℕ)
  (hB : ∀ (i : I) (j : J), OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = true → B i j = U)
  (i₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U)
  (j₀ : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U),
  7 ≤ L →
    (∀
        (z :
          OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L)
        (i : I) (j : J),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U i j = false →
          ∑ k,
              OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.residualRows
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L z k ≤
            B i j) →
      ∀
        (x y :
          OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.PhysicalStates
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) B r c L),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L B hB x y →
          ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.blockCount
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L B i₀)
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L B j₀) x) /
              2 ≤
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.acceptedCount
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L B i₀)
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L B j₀) x y)
